title: Aburi Salmon Nigiri
description: Surface-torched salmon nigiri, with a raw-centered or fully cooked option.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

ingredients.name: Salmon intended for raw consumption, unless cooked

steps: Prepare six lightly packed seasoned rice ovals of about 25 g.
Drape a nigiri-sized salmon slice over each oval.
Briefly torch the exposed salmon surface. If avoiding a raw center, pan-sear the salmon fully before placing it on rice.
Add tiny dots of Kewpie, a sparing brush of soy sauce and optional tobiko.
notes: Aburi torching may leave the center raw, so use salmon appropriately handled for raw consumption.
Baseline makes approximately six light servings. Ingredient quantities can be scaled independently.
Prepare and season sushi rice using its separate recipe.
For uncooked salmon, use a reputable raw-consumption supplier, keep chilled and assemble promptly.
